messages:
nina: quick q  we have a tiny change in the deploy scripts that toggles a feature-flag default. It's infra-only but will affect rollout behavior. Do we mark as patch?

chad: If no external API changes, we normally don't. But toggling a default could change observable behavior for end-users. What's the feature flag?

nina: `enable_batching_by_default` in infra/deploy/flags.yaml. Default toggled false->true. This means new deployments will use batching heuristics unless overridden.

maya: That's tricky. It's a default that affects performance/cost, not API. I'd treat as a consumer-impacting change for anyone relying on latency profiles. Suggest a patch and call it out in release notes.

chad: Could we gate it behind a rollout config? If we roll out to non-critical services first, we might avoid a formal semver bump.

nina: Rollout plan attached: start with analytics job queues, then background workers, then user-facing routes (three waves). Each wave monitored for p99 changes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: detected files changed: infra/deploy/flags.yaml. Auto-bump policy: infra changes -> patch. To force no-bump, add `skip-release-bump: true`.

nina: Hmm. I don't want an automatic patch for this one if we can control rollout. But I do want a release note and an explicit owner.

maya: Maybe adopt a middle-ground: don't bump semver now, but create a release note and a tagged internal changelog entry so downstream teams can opt in. If rollout triggers >5% p95 reg, we cut a patch.

chad: Works. Update PR with `no-auto-bump` comment and the staged rollout plan. Also include a small revert snippet for ops.

nina: Done. Added `skip-release-bump: true`, rollout plan, revert command, and a short release-note line: `infra: enable_batched_deploys default = true (staged rollout)`.

deploy-bot: override acknowledged. No scheduled patch bump. Canary wave 1 at 01:00 UTC.

release-czar: Add to release-draft board as `infra: enable_batched_deploys default enabled (staged)` and tag `monitoring-required`.

maya: Also ping cost team — this impacts GPU tiling and billing models.

nina: pinged @cost-team. Will update after wave 2.

chad: Follow-up item: we should update the auto-bump heuristics so infra toggles that change runtime behavior are triaged to human review instead of auto-patch. Filing a tiny RFC after this thread.

release-czar: noted and added as action item. :memo:
